body:
spring.application.name: telemetry-ingestion-processing
spring.r2dbc.url: ${TELEMETRY_R2DBC_URL}
spring.r2dbc.username: ${TELEMETRY_DB_USER}
spring.r2dbc.password: ${TELEMETRY_DB_PASSWORD}
spring.flyway.enabled: true
spring.flyway.url: ${TELEMETRY_JDBC_URL}
spring.flyway.user: ${TELEMETRY_DB_USER}
spring.flyway.password: ${TELEMETRY_DB_PASSWORD}
spring.flyway.locations: filesystem:db/migrations
telemetry.reorder-window: PT60S
telemetry.reorder-buffer-capacity: 4096
telemetry.validated-stream-capacity: 1024
telemetry.broadcast-capacity: 1024
telemetry.emit-retry-timeout: PT0.1S
telemetry.boundaries[0].metric: HEART_RATE
telemetry.boundaries[0].min: 30
telemetry.boundaries[0].max: 240
telemetry.boundaries[0].min-exclusive: false
telemetry.boundaries[0].enabled: true
telemetry.boundaries[1].metric: POWER
telemetry.boundaries[1].min: 0
telemetry.boundaries[1].max: 2500
telemetry.boundaries[1].min-exclusive: false
telemetry.boundaries[1].enabled: true
telemetry.boundaries[2].metric: CADENCE
telemetry.boundaries[2].min: 0
telemetry.boundaries[2].max: 220
telemetry.boundaries[2].min-exclusive: false
telemetry.boundaries[2].enabled: true
telemetry.boundaries[3].metric: SWIM_PACE
telemetry.boundaries[3].min: 45
telemetry.boundaries[3].max: 100000
telemetry.boundaries[3].min-exclusive: true
telemetry.boundaries[3].enabled: true
telemetry.boundaries[4].metric: GROUND_CONTACT_TIME
telemetry.boundaries[4].min: 0
telemetry.boundaries[4].max: 0
telemetry.boundaries[4].min-exclusive: false
telemetry.boundaries[4].enabled: false
telemetry.boundaries[5].metric: RESPIRATION
telemetry.boundaries[5].min: 0
telemetry.boundaries[5].max: 0
telemetry.boundaries[5].min-exclusive: false
telemetry.boundaries[5].enabled: false
telemetry.boundaries[6].metric: SWIM_STROKE
telemetry.boundaries[6].min: 0
telemetry.boundaries[6].max: 0
telemetry.boundaries[6].min-exclusive: false
telemetry.boundaries[6].enabled: false
logging.level.root: INFO
logging.level.com.blackboard.telemetry: INFO
logging.file.name: logs/telemetry-ingestion-processing.log
logging.structured.format.file: ecs
logging.logback.rollingpolicy.max-file-size: 10MB
logging.logback.rollingpolicy.max-history: 7
management.endpoints.web.exposure.include: health,metrics
---
spring.config.activate.on-profile: test
spring.r2dbc.url: r2dbc:h2:mem:///telemetry;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;NON_KEYWORDS=VALUE
spring.r2dbc.username: sa
spring.r2dbc.password: ''
spring.flyway.enabled: true
spring.flyway.url: jdbc:h2:mem:telemetry;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;NON_KEYWORDS=VALUE
spring.flyway.user: sa
spring.flyway.password: ''
spring.flyway.locations: filesystem:db/migrations
logging.file.name: target/test-logs/telemetry.log
